title: Output of the schedule transition
statement: For every finite Turing machine $W$ over the Boolean alphabet, every $a\in\mathbb{N}$, every state $q$ of the schedule machine determined by $W$ and $a$, every scanned input symbol (possibly blank), and every tuple of work-tape symbols (each possibly blank), the transition emits no output symbol.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite machine over Booleans
q is a state of the schedule machine
The scanned input symbol may be blank
Each work-tape read may be blank
replaced:
For every clock witness $W$ over the Boolean alphabet, every parameter
$a \in \mathbb{N}$, every state $q$ of the length-only schedule, every scanned input
symbol, and every tuple of work-tape reads, the transition of the length-only
schedule emits no output symbol. A decoration supplies the final answer at the
schedule's final halting transition.
